name: Minimata Mahtari Jatan Yojana
benefit: > A lump sum amount of ₹20,000/- will be provided to the registered female construction worker after the birth of the child.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh. 1. The applicant should be a woman worker. 1. The applicant should be registered Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The benefit will only be provided for only first two children. 1. The applicant should be registered as a construction worker 90 days in advance.
**Note:** In case of the death of the beneficiary female worker during delivery, the payment of the Assistance Scheme will be payable to her husband (full amount).
